claim: AXIOM coordinated and reconstructed three-day synthetic operational cycles in software development and logistics/supply-chain, with six work items per domain, multi-day carryover, dynamic arrivals, queue growth and drain, and sustained multi-entity state.
scope: Retained accepted multi-day cycle evidence for software-development-cycle-001 and logistics-supply-chain-cycle-001.
limitations: Supporting evidence is synthetic and bounded to modeled organizations and workloads, not production deployment.
Synthetic ledger values are model accounting evidence, not measured real-world economic performance or benefit.
The evidence does not establish regulatory compliance, arbitrary-enterprise completeness, or exactly-once external effects.
